description:
About the job

Job Overview

Plan A Technologies is seeking a talented PR & Content Marketing Specialist to spearhead our brand narrative and accelerate inbound growth. If you are a master storyteller who thrives at the intersection of B2B tech and creative media, we want you.

We are looking for a prolific writer with 5+ years of experience transforming complex technology concepts into compelling, high-conversion narratives. In this role, you won't just chase headlines—you will strategically craft content that builds authority, commands attention, and turns readers into revenue.

Responsibilities


Shape the Narrative: Co-author and execute our overarching brand and content strategy across all major digital channels.
Drive Inbound Growth: Craft high-impact, client-facing collateral—including proposals, brochures, and targeted campaigns—designed to capture and convert high-value leads.
Media Relations & Pitching: Secure high-tier earned media by building relationships with journalists, tech bloggers, and industry influencers.
Thought Leadership: Author deep-dive white papers, sharp op-eds, and narrative-driven infographics on cutting-edge technology trends.
Social & Virality: Develop punchy, high-engagement content tailored for social platforms to amplify our brand voice and spark industry conversation.
SEO Optimization: Apply robust on-page optimization best practices to ensure our content ranks high and cuts through the digital noise.
Award Recognition: Identify, draft, and submit compelling applications for industry awards to cement Plan A’s market leadership.
Data-Driven Iteration: Track and analyze key performance metrics (open rates, CTRs, conversions) to relentlessly optimize outreach and ROI.


What You Bring


Proven Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in PR, content marketing, or journalism. Deep experience in B2B tech marketing is a massive plus.
Exemplary Craftsmanship: Flawless English prose with the versatility to switch seamlessly between authoritative thought leadership and snappy, conversational copy.
Full-Funnel Content Mastery: A portfolio demonstrating success across emails, blogs, social media, and long-form digital campaigns that measurably move the needle.
SEO Fluency: A strong grasp of search intent, keyword integration, and content optimization strategies.
Agility & Ownership: The organizational horsepower to manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment without sacrificing attention to detail.


About The Company/Benefits

Plan A Technologies is an American software development and technology advisory firm that brings top-tier engineering talent to clients around the world. Our software engineers tackle custom product development projects, staff augmentation, major integrations and upgrades, and much more. The team is far more hands-on than the giant outsourcing shops, but still big enough to handle major enterprise clients.

Read more about us here: www.PlanAtechnologies.com .

Location: Work From Home 100% of the time, or come in to one of our global offices. Up to you.

Great colleagues and an upbeat work environment: You'll join an excellent team of supportive engineers and project managers who work hard but don't ever compete with each other.

Benefits: You’ll get a generous vacation schedule, a brand new laptop, and other goodies.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok e-Commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-Commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience.  Analytical mindset with basic knowledge of data analysis and reporting.


Preferred Qualification


 Previous internship or extracurricular experience in marketing, e-commerce, digital content, operations, or project coordination is a plus.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

About the job

Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,200 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.




The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:




80% Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

Your primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.




20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business Support

We're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.




Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.




We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.
Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.




4) Partnership With Leadership

Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.
Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.
Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.
Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.




5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.
Write engaging candidate outreach messages.
Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.

description:
About the job

Founding LinkedIn Outbound Campaign Strategist

Hey! We’re Scale Up, and our client is looking to hire a LinkedIn Lead Generation Specialist for a fast-growing AI startup building an AI-powered growth platform for LinkedIn outbound.

Type of Employment: Full-Time Contractor (Long-term)

Work Modality: 100% Remote

Work Schedule: Full-Time

Location: Global

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing AI startup building technology that helps companies identify the right prospects, start highly relevant conversations, and turn those conversations into qualified sales meetings.

They are looking for someone who is exceptional at LinkedIn outbound. This is not a role for someone who simply uploads prospect lists and creates standard sequences. They need someone who can understand a business, identify the strongest reasons to reach out, define the right audience, create messaging that generates genuine responses, and continuously improve campaigns based on real performance data.

You will have significant ownership, managing campaigns from initial research and strategy through launch, testing, and ongoing optimization.

What You’ll Own


Learn each client’s product, market, customers, positioning, and sales process. 
Identify the strongest ICPs, buyer segments, triggers, and campaign angles. 
Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other data sources. 
Determine who to target, why they would care, and why the timing is relevant. 
Write connection requests, opening messages, follow-ups, and campaign variations. 
Build and launch LinkedIn outbound campaigns using the company’s platform. 
Monitor acceptance, reply, positive reply, meeting, attendance, and lead-quality rates. 
Identify where campaigns are underperforming and make the necessary adjustments. 
Run structured tests across audiences, offers, messaging, and CTAs. 
Review replies and conversations to understand what the market is actually saying. 
Pause weak campaigns quickly and scale the ones that work. 
Maintain clear campaign documentation covering tests, results, and learnings. 
Turn successful campaigns into repeatable playbooks for the broader team. 


What Exceptional Looks Like

You can look at a company and quickly answer:


Who is most likely to buy this? 
What signals suggest they may need it right now? 
Who should we exclude from the campaign? 
What would make the outreach feel specific without sounding automated? 
Is the problem the audience, offer, message, timing, or follow-up? 
What does the campaign data tell us to change next? 


You understand that great outbound is not about sending more messages. It is about creating the right conversation with the right person at the right time.

You May Be a Great Fit If


You have built and optimized successful B2B outbound campaigns. 
You are extremely strong in ICP research, segmentation, targeting, and outbound copywriting. 
You have deep hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. 
You can write messages that are concise, casual, relevant, and genuinely human. 
You understand the difference between getting a reply and generating a qualified sales opportunity. 
You are comfortable working across multiple industries and quickly learning new markets. 
You use campaign data to make decisions rather than relying only on intuition. 
You can diagnose targeting and messaging problems and act on them quickly. 
You take full ownership and are comfortable working with minimal supervision. 
You can clearly explain why a campaign worked, why it failed, and what should happen next. 
You care deeply about the quality and business impact of your work. 


Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, HeyReach, Expandi, Smartlead, Unipile, or similar outbound platforms is a plus, but results and strategic thinking matter more than the exact tool stack.

This Is Probably Not for You If


Your outbound strategy is mainly based on increasing volume. 
You rely heavily on generic templates with light personalization. 
You evaluate campaigns only through acceptance or overall reply rates. 
You need someone else to define the audience, angle, and offer. 
You launch campaigns and wait weeks before analyzing their performance. 
You cannot provide examples of campaigns you personally built and improved. 
Your messaging sounds like it was generated by a sales automation tool. 


How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be evaluated based on:


Quality and precision of targeting. 
Positive reply rate. 
Qualified meetings booked. 
Meeting attendance and lead quality. 
Speed and quality of campaign iteration. 
Client campaign performance over time. 
Strength of the insights and playbooks you produce. 


The focus is on qualified meetings, real sales opportunities, and revenue potential. Vanity metrics matter only when they help diagnose and improve campaign performance.

What Your First 90 Days Could Look Like

First 30 Days


Learn the product, customers, and existing campaign process. 
Audit current campaigns and identify the biggest performance opportunities. 
Take ownership of an initial group of campaigns. 
Establish a clear testing and reporting approach. 


By 60 Days


Independently research, build, launch, and optimize campaigns. 
Produce measurable improvements in targeting, messaging, or conversion rates. 
Turn early wins into repeatable campaign frameworks. 
Identify recurring process issues and propose improvements. 


By 90 Days


Own campaign strategy and execution with minimal oversight. 
Consistently generate qualified conversations through outbound campaigns. 
Raise the quality bar across the company’s campaigns. 
Help develop a world-class system for LinkedIn outbound. 


Why Join?


Work directly with the founder and have meaningful ownership from day one. 
Join a fast-growing startup where your work directly impacts customer results. 
Help shape both the campaign strategy and the AI-powered product behind it. 
Test strategies across different markets, offers, industries, and audiences. 
Play a key role in defining what world-class LinkedIn outbound looks like. 
Work remotely as part of an ambitious, highly autonomous team. 


Thanks!

About the job

About the Role




We are an international Tourism Marketing & Communications Agency dedicated to promoting some of the world’s most exciting travel destinations, airlines, hotels, car rental companies and tourism brands.

We are looking for a talented and highly creative Social Media Manager to join our digital marketing team in Mexico City and manage social media accounts for our tourism clients.




If you are a creative storyteller with a proven track record of growing and engaging social audiences, a strong understanding of the Mexican digital landscape, and experience creating impactful social media and video content, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.




Responsibilities: 

As our Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive organic and paid social media strategies for our clients. You will create and curate engaging content, manage social communities, oversee campaigns and help translate our clients’ brands and travel experiences into compelling stories for Mexican and Latin American audiences.




Your role will include:

Developing and implementing organic and paid social media strategies aligned with each client’s brand and business objectives
Creating, editing, producing, publishing and curating engaging social media content on an ongoing basis
Developing original copy, short-form video and other social-first content
Maintaining strong and consistent brand identities across social platforms

Setting and monitoring content marketing, audience growth and engagement KPIs
Planning and managing paid social media campaigns
Measuring, evaluating and reporting results, insights and trends to clients, partners and stakeholders
Proactively identifying content opportunities and emerging social media trends relevant to our clients
Making strategic recommendations to improve engagement, reach and overall campaign performance
Developing content distribution strategies to maximize organic and paid reach across appropriate channels
Working with graphic designers and other creative resources to develop high-quality visual content
Identifying and engaging with relevant influencers and content creators
Managing online communities and responding to followers in a timely and brand-appropriate manner
Staying current on social media trends, platform developments, digital technologies and evolving audience behaviors




Skills and Qualifications

We are looking for a creative and strategic thinker who can bring travel brands and destinations to life through compelling content.




The ideal candidate will have:

5+ years of professional experience in social media management, content creation and digital marketing across multiple platforms and audience segments
Experience working with travel, tourism, hospitality or lifestyle brands is highly desirable
Strong knowledge of the Mexican social media and digital landscape
Demonstrated experience with organic and paid social media campaigns
Excellent writing and communication skills in Spanish
Strong professional proficiency in English, as the role involves working with international clients and partners
Experience creating and producing social-first and short-form video content
Experience managing and providing creative direction to graphic designers
Familiarity with social media management and content management platforms such as Sprout Social or similar tools
Strong working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager and other major social media advertising platforms
Experience with platforms including Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
A passion for storytelling and the ability to adapt content to different brand voices and audiences
An analytical mindset and the ability to interpret performance data and optimize content accordingly
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts, deadlines and priorities
Creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach
A solid understanding of how content marketing, paid media, social media, influencer marketing, PR and email marketing work together to support broader business objectives




This is an exciting opportunity to work with international tourism brands and help shape how destinations and travel experiences are presented to audiences in Mexico and Latin America.




We are looking for someone who combines creativity with strategy,  someone who understands what makes great social content, but also understands that social media must ultimately support our clients’ marketing and business objectives.

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Application: Apply via LinkedIn




Join us in inspiring travel, building tourism brands and connecting travelers with unforgettable experiences around the worldl.

title: Dispatch Coordinator
description:
About the job

 📃 Role Summary: 




Join AMB Logistics as a Dispatch Coordinator, a pivotal role who will be the frontline representative in a dynamic company. This role is a highly organized and detail-oriented position responsible for scheduling and tracking of freight in Mexico, US, Canada, (including cross-border routes). You will ensure operational excellence through precise shipment tracking, carrier management, and strict adherence to documentation protocols acting as a crucial link between shippers, carriers, and customers.




✅ Key Responsibilities:




- Improve the shipment lifecycle management by coordinating pick-ups and deliveries, ensuring all data matches according to customer’s requirements.

- Ensure a proactive tracking along with timely communication by monitoring shipments and providing transparent updates to internal and external clients. 

- Negotiate and manage any dispute resolution of any on-road issues, including lumper fees, detentions and layovers.

- Establish and maintain carrier relations by negotiating rates and secure capacity using tech-driven tools.

- Obtain, validate and maintain accurate records of shipping documents and transactions.

- Collaborate with team members to optimize operational processes. 

- Support in handling inquiries from potential clients and converting them to confirmed orders.

- Focusing on optimizing daily workflows, reducing costs, and increasing efficiency in supply chains.




🎓 Requirements:




- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

- 2-3+ years of proven relevant logistics experience. 

- Bilingual (Spanish/English) for cross-border operations. Advanced english written and verbal required (90%). 

- Proficiency in transportation management system software. 

- Demonstrated expertise with Word, Excel and other Office suite applications.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating professionalism in all interactions in order to resolve issues.

- Strong collaboration, teamwork, leader and organizational skills. 

- Ability to work under pressure and independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

- Ability to interpret a variety of instructions provided in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule form.

- Analytical and reasoning skills for escalation to supervisor/leadership

- Strong multitasking, prioritization, communication, and problem-solving abilities are essential to handle urgent, changing logistics situations.




🌟 Nice to Haves:




- Experience working in a remote setup. 

- Familiarity with freight load boards. 

- Drayage experience in Mexico and USA is a big plus.




🚀 If you are passionate about logistics, possess exceptional organizational skills, and are eager to join a growing company, we encourage you to apply.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you'll do

Responsibilities


Have the opportunity to join an operations team across Risk, Product Support, and Financial Crimes
Troubleshoot and solve complex problems
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams across the globe
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You are a recent graduate with less than 12 months of full-time working experience or a 2025 or 2026 graduate with full-time availability.
You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes. You are an organized self-starter with a passion for finding solutions to our users' challenges.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Our vision is not just to improve CX. It is to reinvent how businesses leverage technology, data, and human expertise to create intelligent, scalable, and revenue-generating service models.




MAIN JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Analytics Engineer owns data modeling for a portfolio of client accounts and builds the shared metric models that every account depends on. This role consolidates core contact center metrics onto master dimensions and shared definitions so that onboarding a new client becomes largely a configuration exercise, while also building the data layer behind a client-facing analytics product. This is a hands-on modeling role, focused on production data models rather than infrastructure, orchestration, or CI configuration.

Account Modeling and Delivery:

Own data modeling for a portfolio of small, medium, and large client accounts, from ingested source data through to serving-ready output.

Translate requirements that arrive as a spreadsheet and a conversation into a specification that can be built and tested.

Contribute to architectural decision records when a modeling decision is worth writing down.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.

Responsibilities
Creators are at the center of our operations. Through professional agencies and MCNs in the content business, especially those that specialize in livestreaming, we are building scale and democratization of the livestreaming business. In this role of Agency Growth Manager, you will carry out two main sets of responsibilities that will drive business growth in a sustainable way:

Agency Management
 - Design TikTok LIVE LATAM's agency growth strategy for recruiting, retaining, and helping agencies scale up in their business on the platform. 
 - Design agency's benefit system and growth program to incentivize better performance and sustainable revenue growth.
 - Conduct day-to-day management directly with agency managers and their creators to materialize and iterate the strategic programs to deliver business results. Provide additional support to agencies and their creators for the needs related to content and platform guidelines. 
 - Build LIVE showcases with successful agencies and increase the positive impact of working with the platform in the agency community.
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams to carry out in-app and out-of-app campaigns and drive participation and results from agency creators.
 - Monitor results metrics for agency growth and performance, and conduct regular analysis to generate operational insights for improvement.

Agency Education and Capacity Building
 - Design LIVE's agency empowerment program with practical tips and know-how about how to scale up agency's operation and revenue potential with a focus on agency professionalization.
 - Facilitate business and industry knowledge transfer from top agencies to emerging agencies, learn from global best practices and localize the expertise to educate local agencies on how to scale.
 - Share the platform know-how on content tips and trends to agencies to improve their creators' LIVE performance and revenue generation.
 - Conduct training to agencies for the above mentioned topics, leveraging different tools and social platforms.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above.
- More than 2 years of working experience relates to creator management, especially managing influencer agencies and/or MCNs.
- Candidates who are sensitive to cultural trends, possess a good understanding of the content industry, creator economy and business acumen on newly emerged industries are preferred. 
- Professional, patient, and skillful communication with talents/influencers. 
- Result-oriented and data-driven operation.
- Proficient in both verbal and written English since business communication with global teams are in English.

Preferred Qualifications
- Candidates who are used to work with, or have connections with modeling, content, media, TV, celebrities, and livestreaming platforms.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. Buscamos a un diseñador proactivo y autodidacta, con sólido criterio visual y mucho orden, que disfrute resolver problemas, proponer soluciones viables y llevar cada proyecto a su mejor nivel de calidad en todas sus etapas.




Lo que harás

· Conceptualización y diseño: creación de conceptos de nombre, identidad, marcas, señalética y editorial, además de logotipos, imágenes originales e ilustraciones, según los lineamientos de Lead Designers y Directores Creativos.

· Manuales y presentaciones: generación de manuales de identidad y señalética, y de presentaciones impresas o digitales para exponer conceptos al equipo y a clientes.

· Producción gráfica: generación de archivos de producción, cotización con proveedores y validación de la calidad del material recibido.

· Colaboración y seguimiento: seguimiento de cronogramas de entrega, seguimiento de proyectos con Clientes, Coordinadores y Directores Creativos, y colaboración con otras disciplinas como interiorismo, diseño industrial y arquitectura.




Lo que buscamos

· 5 Años de experiencia como mínimo. No es una candidatura para recién egresados.

· La oferta es para un puesto de tiempo completo + presencial, no remoto ni híbrido.

· Sólido criterio de diseño y atención al detalle.

· Actitud proactiva y autodidacta para resolver proyectos con el nivel de calidad esperado.

· Orden y capacidad de organización del tiempo y prioridades para cumplir cronogramas.

· Dominio indispensable de Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign).

· Comportamiento colaborativo y buena comunicación con el equipo y los clientes.




Tecnología que usarás

Trabajarás con Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign) como herramientas indispensables, además de Asana para la gestión de tareas y ERP para el seguimiento de proyectos. Nos interesa alguien al día con las herramientas de diseño y de Ai —o con ganas de explorarlas— para elevar la calidad y eficiencia del trabajo.




Cómo trabajamos en Pólvora

En Pólvora cuidamos un ambiente de trabajo sano, dinámico y con fuerte sentido de equipo. Valoramos el orden, la colaboración y la mejora continua de nuestros procesos. Buscamos personas que disfruten trabajar de forma estructurada, aporten ideas y crezcan junto con el equipo.




Qué ofrecemos

· Sueldo a negociar de acuerdo con experiencia.

· Prestaciones de Ley.




Cómo postularte

Envíanos tu portafolio y CV a jobs@polvora.com. Solamente los trabajos que cumplan con los estándares de calidad y afinidad a nuestro estudio serán considerados para una entrevista de seguimiento. Nos pondremos en contacto contigo.

description:
About the job

If you want to use the latest in CRO, experimentation, UX, and usability, this is the right job for you. You will have the opportunity to work with the world's top experts on conversion optimization!

 

We’re Invesp — the leading conversion optimization agency in North America. We’ve run over 36,000 A/B tests, helped clients like eBay, 3M, and O’Reilly boost revenue, and we’re on the hunt for an Account Manager who’s ready to lead client relationships and drive growth through smarter experimentation.

 

At Invesp, you can bring your most authentic self to work, merging your personal and professional lives.

 

As a conversion optimization strategist, you will work closely with our CRO team to help them identify conversion opportunities on client platforms, develop solutions, and oversee the implementation of these solutions as AB tests.

 

Our Values:

Every detail matters—which is why we never cut corners on how we present our work, communicate internally, or deliver for clients. Every detail reflects on us.
Extreme Ownership. Great agency work depends on trust. Everyone on the team needs to own their role fully—because the whole only works when every part is solid.
We take full responsibility—spot the issue, take action, and follow through without being asked.
Ask: “What else can I do?” Go beyond the task. Look for the extra step that adds value.
Reject Average. Don’t settle. Push for work that’s sharp, thoughtful, and above the standard.

 

What You’ll Do:

 

You will be responsible for the success of your projects, with a focus on efficiency, timeline, and budget. You are responsible for analyzing client sites, purchase funnels, and customer journeys to identify conversion leaks and revenue opportunities. 

 

You will work closely with our project managers, development team, designers, and stakeholders to ensure that the project tasks are well-defined, prioritized to maximize value and ROI, and executed in a timely fashion with the highest standards of quality. You’re the strategic brain behind the project.

 

You’ll:

Set clear goals and expectations for the experimentation program for each of your clients.
Work with our user research and data analysis teams to identify conversion gaps. 
Collaborate with designers to ensure that designs match your hypothesis
Collaborate with developers and QAs to ensure AB experiments are delivered on time and bug-free
Conduct post-test analysis and communicate insights. 
Help clients fall in love with conversion rate optimization (if they aren’t already)

 

You’ll Thrive Here If You

Have 2+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization
Have 3+ years of experience working in an agency environment
Extremely detail-oriented and organized
Can explain CRO concepts in simple, persuasive language
Know how to tell a good story using data, not just charts
Take pride in your work and always look for ways to deliver more value
Ability to work proactively and independently
Advanced or Native-level English proficiency (both spoken and written)

 

Bonus Points If You:

Have experience managing digital campaigns or clients in the ecommerce or SaaS space
Have a background in digital advertising, analytics, or UX
Experience in GA4, Google Ads, and paid social

 

Why Join Invesp?

100% remote-first team — we’ve been remote since before it was cool
Clear ownership of your accounts with autonomy and support
Fast-growing, well-respected agency with top-tier clients and a 90%+ retention rate
Smart, humble, data-driven teammates who love what they do

 

Working Hours for Candidates Outside North and South America

We welcome global applicants, but this role requires availability for internal and client meetings primarily within North American and European time zones. Your core working hours will be 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday, to align with team and client schedules. 

 

The remainder of your schedule is flexible and can be planned around these core and ad hoc commitments.

 

This is a full-time, remote position. We care less about where you went to school and more about how you think, communicate, and take ownership. If you’re curious, collaborative, and excited to help great companies grow smarter — apply now or DM us directly. Let’s talk.

Quick 15 minute interview
45min technical interview
Cultural interview (60 to 75 minutes)
Offer letter

About the job

About Us

Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About The Role

Context & Mission: 

Viaccess-Orca (VO), a subsidiary of Orange Group, delivers video and security solutions for operators worldwide. In LATAM, VO provides the backend, front-end, and security layers of a video platform, integrating with multiple external systems and technologies. This position is for a Senior System Engineer who will be a key technical contributor in the deployment, integration, and support of complex video delivery platforms. While the role does not include formal team leadership, the engineer is expected to collaborate closely with technical leaders, internal teams, and customer stakeholders, acting as a pillar in the execution of technical activities with ownership and accountability. The environment is mission-critical and technically demanding, with opportunities to work hands-on, interface with international teams, and grow technical depth across cloud-native and video delivery ecosystems. Main Responsibilities: Engineering & Execution 


 Participate in the integration, deployment, configuration, and testing of software components. 
 Troubleshoot and resolve system issues in development and production environments (Level 2/3 support). 
 On call support for incidents management. 
 Assist in maintenance activities and implementation of changes in coordination with the team. 
 Document solutions, configurations, and procedures to support maintainability. 


Customer Interaction 


 Work directly with customer technical teams during project execution and support phases. 
 Provide clear, professional communication (written and verbal) in both proactive and reactive interactions. 
 Participate in knowledge transfer sessions and, when applicable, assist with customer training. 


Collaboration & Coordination 


 Coordinate activities with internal stakeholders (R&D, Product, DevOps, Project Management). 
 Provide visibility on progress, risks, and technical issues to project and technical leaders. 
 Ensure alignment of execution with business and project priorities. 


Continuous Improvement 


 Contribute to the definition and enhancement of operational and technical standards. 
 Participate in post-incident reviews and propose improvements to prevent recurrence. 
 Support the evolution of the solution towards cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, MongoDB, microservices). 


Technical Environment: 


 OS & Infrastructure: Advanced Linux administration, proxy configuration, F5 load balancers, basic networking (DNS, VPN, routing) 
 Monitoring & Observability: ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Grafana, Fluent Bit 
 Scripting & Automation: Bash, Python, or Perl 
 Middleware & Databases: JBoss, Squid, Oracle, MongoDB 
 Modernization Stack: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices architecture 
 Video Delivery Ecosystem: DRM, packaging, CDN integration, CRM, media players, UI frameworks 


Required Experience and Skills: Technical Skills 


 Minimum 5 years of experience in systems integration, infrastructure, or platform engineering. 
 Hands-on experience in Linux-based systems, scripting, and middleware setup. 
 Familiarity with video delivery concepts and/or OTT platforms is a plus. 
 Experience in environments using Agile and ITIL service management practices. 
 Exposure to cloud-native tools (Kubernetes, containers) is highly desirable. 


Soft Skills


 Strong written and verbal communication skills in customer-facing contexts. 
 Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across different time zones. 
 High level of ownership, attention to detail, and problem-solving mindset. 
 Willingness to learn, take initiative, and grow within a dynamic technical environment. 


Languages 


 English: Fluent (mandatory – spoken and written)

Performance Objectives 


 Deliver integration and support tasks effectively, with high technical quality. 
 Collaborate efficiently with team members and maintain strong communication with customers. 
 L2/L3 support for incidents contributing with troubleshooting, restoration and investigation. 
 Escalate complex technical cases to Level 4 support, ensuring timely follow-up and effective communication to facilitate accurate incident and problem resolution 
 Ensure platform stability and reliability by executing tasks with precision.

You hold an Engineering degree in Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, IT, or a closely related technical field with over 10 years of experience in multi-technology environments, including more than 5 years focused on system integration.

You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills.

About the job

Einleitung

Du löst gerne komplexe Aufgaben und behältst auch bei kniffligen Fällen den Überblick? Dann passt Du perfekt in unser Team.

Bei Peter Park digitalisieren wir die Parkbranche und machen aus gewöhnlichen Parkflächen smarte Mobility Hubs. Für unser Support-Team suchen wir Verstärkung im 2nd und 3rd Level. Du übernimmst die Anliegen, die über den Standard-Support hinausgehen, gehst technischen Ursachen auf den Grund und sorgst für verlässliche Lösungen für unsere Endkundinnen und -kunden.

Was ist Deine Aufgabe?


2nd & 3rd Level Support: Bearbeitung eskalierter Tickets aus dem 1st Level – von technischen Störungen bis zu komplexen Abrechnungs- und Systemthemen.
Ticketbearbeitung im Fokus: Fokus auf die zügige, sorgfältige und eigenständige Abarbeitung von Anfragen im Tagesgeschäft.
Tiefergehende Analyse: Schnelles Erfassen komplexer Sachverhalte und gezielte Einordnung, ob ein Fall direkt gelöst oder intern abgeklärt werden muss.
Schnittstelle zu Product & Tech: Enge Abstimmung mit Product & Tech bei technischen Störungen, die über den Support-Rahmen hinausgehen.
Datenschutz & Compliance: Professioneller Umgang mit sensiblen Anfragen rund um Datenschutz im Rahmen bestehender Vorgaben.
Qualität im Ticket-System: Sauberes Dokumentieren von Lösungswegen im Peter Park Ticket System, damit Wissen für 1st Level und Team nutzbar bleibt.


Deine Fähigkeiten


Berufserfahrung: Mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Support, idealerweise mit Erfahrung im 2nd/3rd Level oder technischen Support.
Technisches Verständnis: Gutes Grundverständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und die Fähigkeit, diese verständlich zu erklären.
Rechtliches Grundinteresse: Freude daran, Dich tiefer in komplexere Tickets mit rechtlichem Bezug (z. B. Vertragsrecht, Datenschutz oder AGB) einzufuchsen.
Hands-On & Analyse: Ausgeprägte Hands-On-Mentalität, sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Souveränität: Analytische Denkweise, Eigeninitiative und ein ruhiges, professionelles Auftreten auch bei eskalierten Anfragen.
Selbstorganisation im Remote-Setup: Hohes Maß an Selbstorganisation und Zuverlässigkeit für das eigenverantwortliche Arbeiten im Homeoffice.
Tool-Kompetenz: Sicherer Umgang mit Ticket-/CRM-Systemen (z. B. Zendesk, Freshdesk, Hubspot oder ähnlich); MS Office selbstverständlich.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift.


Work Setup


100% Remote, Arbeitsort: Deutschland 
40 Stunden pro Woche (Vertrauensbasis)
Arbeitszeiten: Montag bis Freitag, keine Schichtarbeit
Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
Team: 8 Kolleg:innen, Team-Hub in München, gelegentliche Teamevents/Office-Besuche vor Ort möglich

Über uns

Peter Park hilft seinen Kund:innen dabei, die Gestaltung von Parkräumen einfach und digital abzubilden. The Director of Talent Acquisition will be responsible for overseeing all recruitment efforts for Mexico and U.S. operations, ensuring Avantive attracts, hires, and retains the talent necessary to support current operations and future growth objectives.

This role requires executive-level leadership, strategic vision, and operational excellence. The Director will own the talent acquisition strategy, recruitment budget, sourcing investments, workforce planning initiatives, and recruiting performance across multiple regions.

The Director will partner closely with Executive Leadership, HR, Operations, Finance, and Marketing teams to develop scalable hiring strategies, strengthen employer branding, improve candidate quality, and ensure recruiting efforts are aligned with business objectives.

This is a high-impact leadership role that demands strong business acumen, cross-cultural collaboration, labor market expertise, and the ability to lead large-scale hiring initiatives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.




III. Primary Responsibilities

• Develop and execute the overall talent acquisition strategy for both Mexico and U.S. operations

• Own the recruiting budget; monitor spend, ROI, vendor performance, and cost-per-hire across all sourcing channels

• Ensure alignment between recruiting initiatives, workforce planning, and Avantive’s global growth strategy

• Partner closely with Executive Leadership, HR, Operations, and Finance teams to forecast hiring needs and support business expansion plans

• Drive workforce planning initiatives to proactively address staffing needs across programs, clients, and locations

• Identify attrition drivers and recommend improvements to hiring profiles, selection processes, onboarding, and candidate experience

• Ensure compliance with recruiting policies, employment regulations, and hiring practices in both countries

• Lead, mentor, and develop recruiters, and support staff while creating a high-performance recruiting organization.

• Establish recruiting KPIs, accountability measures, and performance standards across all recruiting functions

• Ensure strong, data-driven reporting on hiring performance, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, funnel conversion, quality of hire, and recruiting productivity

• Standardize and improve recruiting processes across regions to maximize efficiency, scalability, and candidate quality

• Monitor labor market trends, competitor hiring practices, compensation benchmarks, and emerging recruitment technologies

• Bring innovative ideas and strategic recommendations regarding sourcing strategies, talent attraction, automation, AI tools, and recruiting operations

• Partner with Marketing and HR to strengthen Avantive’s employer brand and candidate attraction strategies

• Serve as a strategic advisor to leadership regarding talent market conditions, workforce availability, and recruiting risks




IV. Qualifications & Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience in high-volume recruiting, talent acquisition, or workforce planning, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role / Director Role

• Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or related field; Master’s preferred

• Fully bilingual (Spanish/English), with strong cross-cultural communication skills

• Proven success leading large-scale, high-volume recruiting organizations supporting both Mexico and U.S. operations

• Experience managing recruiting budgets, vendor relationships, sourcing investments, and workforce planning initiatives

• Demonstrated success building and scaling recruiting teams in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments

• Hands-on experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATSs), recruiting technologies, and talent analytics platforms

• Strong understanding of both Mexico and U.S. labor markets, employment practices, compliance requirements, and competitive dynamics

• Experience in high-volume recruiting within call center or BPO.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive business decisions and recruiting performance

• Strong leadership, organizational, strategic planning, and change management skills

• Experience partnering directly with executive leadership on workforce strategy and organizational growth initiatives

• Willing to travel as needed to Mexico City sites; valid U.S. visa preferred but not required




V. Key Competencies

• Strategic and visionary leadership

• Data-driven, with a focus on measurable outcomes

• Strong business and financial acumen

• Executive presence and stakeholder management

• Comfortable managing cross-border teams and large-scale recruiting operations

• Expertise in workforce planning and talent acquisition strategy

• Resilient, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Collaborative leadership style with a global mindset

• Results-oriented with strong ownership and accountability




VI. Compensation & Benefits

Avantive Solutions offers a competitive compensation package designed to support your well-being, professional growth, and overall work experience. We provide a full suite of benefits that make Avantive an employer of choice in Mexico:

• 12 paid vacation days per year, plus a 50% vacation premium

• 20 days of Aguinaldo annually

• Food vouchers and a savings fund to support financial planning and stability

• Robust training programs, access to career development opportunities, and a strong culture of promoting from within

• A fun, inclusive, and motivating workplace where collaboration and innovation are valued

• Comprehensive health coverage and wellness initiatives to support you and your family

This position also comes with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Avantive’s global growth, with visibility to senior leadership and clear pathways for future career advancement.

About the job

Job description

Basis Theory is a compliant and developer-friendly platform for securing, using, and managing sensitive data. We work with innovative companies from fast-moving startups like Melio and Passes to large merchants like Roku and Pinterest.




The team at Basis Theory is building from first-hand experience at Twilio, Klarna, and Dwolla and has raised over $45 million from Bessemer Venture Partners, Kindred Ventures, and others. We are a remote-first, distributed company with a team-based culture and an annual company offsite (the last few have been in Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Barcelona, and Mexico).

We are looking for an ambitious self-starter to help maximize our sales and marketing efforts. The SDR helps generate new business by identifying and converting leads into qualified sales opportunities through targeted campaigns. The SDR role is an important top of the sales funnel position and will often be the customer’s first point of contact. From there, you will work with sales and marketing to determine the appropriate next steps. This is an opportunity to join on the ground floor of building the go-to-market engine for a fast-growing start-up.




What You Will Do:

Be the first point of contact for new potential customers at Basis Theory.
Create potential opportunities from outbound prospecting.
Nurture leads through various outbound channels.
Keep all prospects warm and ensure no meeting gets missed.
Collaborate with the team to plan and conduct concentrated campaigns and forward-thinking customer outreach.
Meet and exceed quotas by creating new outbound opportunities.
Develop and implement best practices for growing our customer base.

Experience processing vendor invoices or accounts payable documentation; experience with ECS or a similar ERP system is preferred.
Strong organizational, follow-up, problem-solving, communication, and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple shipments and priorities, maintain accurate records, meet deadlines, and resolve routine operational issues.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish with internal and external stakeholders.
description:
About the job

POSITION SUMMARY

The International Logistics Coordinator manages and supports cross-border logistics operations across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The position coordinates ocean imports, container movement, transportation providers, customer shipments, vendor invoices, and related operational processes to help ensure the accurate and timely movement of products. The role works closely with internal teams and external logistics partners to maintain effective communication, resolve operational issues, and support efficient day-to-day logistics activities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop, document, maintain, and improve procedures for ocean import and cross-border logistics operations. 
Coordinate container shipments and deliveries and follow up on delays, exceptions, and other outstanding matters. 
Support Tijuana ground transportation, warehouse activities, and related operational requirements.
Communicate and coordinate with freight forwarders, ocean carriers, customs brokers, transportation providers, warehouses, and internal departments. 
Identify and evaluate new logistics and service providers based on operational needs. 
Establish and maintain effective communication channels for ocean freight and related logistics activities. 
Prepare and maintain accurate import, container, shipment, and service-provider documentation and records. 
Enter vendor invoices into ECS, maintain accounts payable support records, and follow up with Finance as needed. 
Create shipping labels and prepare related documentation for U.S. and Canadian shipments. 
Route Amazon U.S. and Amazon Canada orders in accordance with applicable customer and carrier requirements. 
Coordinate prepaid U.S. orders and monitor shipments through completion. 
Maintain shipment records and communicate delays, exceptions, and status updates to the appropriate internal and external parties. 
Perform other related logistics and operational duties as assigned based on business needs.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

At least two years of experience in international logistics, import operations, freight coordination, supply chain, transportation, or a related field.
Working knowledge of ocean freight, container movements, shipping documentation, and cross-border logistics.
Experience coordinating with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouses, and service providers.
Experience processing vendor invoices or accounts payable documentation; experience with ECS or a similar ERP system is preferred.
Strong organizational, follow-up, problem-solving, communication, and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple shipments and priorities, maintain accurate records, meet deadlines, and resolve routine operational issues.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Business development hunter
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

DiDi is the world's largest mobility technology platform. With over 10 years in the market, we are the leading company in smart transportation, food delivery, and app-based payment services. Every day, we make life easier and better for millions of people.

By joining DiDi, you will become part of an open, inclusive, and diverse community of more than 12,000 employees worldwide. From day one, you will find a collaborative global culture where your responsibilities have a direct impact on the company's strategy and growth.

In this role, you'll be...

The main mission of a Hunter is to drive driver acquisition through field sales. Your job will be to actively approach prospective drivers, especially those currently active in the industry—in high-potential field channels such as shopping centers, high-traffic areas, and transport stations. We are looking for profiles with a strong commercial orientation, persuasive ability, and a proactive mindset, who enjoy face-to-face contact and are successful in convincing drivers to join DiDi. This position will be key to the strategic growth of DiDi's driver base in your city. Responsibilities:

Prospect and approach potential drivers in field channels (shopping centers, events, high-traffic areas).

Persuasively present DiDi's value proposition to convince drivers active in the industry to migrate to the platform.

Build and manage strong relationships with partners and spaces that enable driver acquisition.

Execute acquisition strategies to meet and exceed established goals.

Follow up and report results, ensuring accuracy in CRM systems.

Provide feedback on market dynamics, competitor strategies, and new opportunities for frictionless recruitment.

Represent DiDi with professionalism, enthusiasm, and consistency in the field.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Bachelor's degree desirable (not mandatory).

3+ years of experience in field sales, business development, or driver acquisition (ideally in mobility, retail, or mass consumer goods).

Hunter mindset: proactive, competitive, resilient, and autonomous.

Proven track record of meeting ambitious commercial goals.

Excellent persuasion, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.

Ability to work in dynamic and fast-paced environments with clear deadlines.

Availability to work in the field in different areas of the city (80% field work).

Basic knowledge of Excel and CRM.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.
